text: Long night, sorry if this is all over the place. I've got my niece for the week, she's 4 and came down with chickenpox two days ago. Spots everywhere now and she's itching like mad, I've been dabbing calamine on them, but apart from that she's actually fine in herself. Tonight though her temperature's gone up to 39.4 which threw me a bit. The other thing is she hasn't done a poo in three days and she is NOT happy about it, very grumpy, keeps going to sit on the toilet and stomping back out. Not sure if that's connected to the chickenpox or just being out of her routine at mine. I've been offering her plenty of water and some fruit. I'm absolutely knackered, she's been up and down and so have I. Is the temperature okay to manage at home with medicine, and is there anything gentle I can do about the poo situation
